name: Dusk Oud
territory: Warm, culturally resonant premium direction built from sand, oud, and desert-dusk material references — not flag-color mimicry. A deep terracotta-ember primary against warm stone neutrals, with an antique-gold accent for restrained moments of richness.
dominanceRatio: 75% warm neutrals (sand/stone background, surface, text, border) · 17% terracotta-ember primary (CTAs, active states, focus) · 8% antique-gold accent + semantic (used sparingly for premium accents and status)
primaryAppearsWhere: Primary CTA, active nav/tab, focus rings, key highlight moments (e.g. a featured campaign pack), the logo tile background on marketing surfaces.
primaryMustNotAppearWhere: Body/result text, large full-bleed screens (a wall of terracotta reads heavy, not premium), borders on generated Visual Studio imagery, disabled or destructive states.
logoUsage: Context-dependent: black on the warm off-white/sand background and light neutral surfaces, white on dark oud-brown or on the terracotta primary. Logo stays strictly monochrome black/white; warmth lives in the surrounding chrome, never recolors the mark.
